title: Truth Packages
subtitle: Test your grasp of Truth Packages — 72+ hour E.B.S. flood gates, soft-to-hard disclosure, Whitehat media seizure, and the path into tribunals and ascension.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Truth Packages are the 72+ hour E.B.S. flood gates that shatter Sleepers false reality after military media seizure. Sit with what you missed, then return to the Truth Packages deep-dive, infographics, and video transmissions. Soft reassurance becomes hard proof—outrage becomes awakening—and the path opens to tribunals, reconstruction, and the sky’s higher-density bleed-through.

questions.question: What is the E.B.S. operation designed to do to humanity’s false reality?

options.label: A
options.text: Only restore Cabal media ownership with no Whitehat military broadcast takeover at all.
options.rationale: Military and Whitehats seize media and internet to broadcast Truth Packages.

options.label: B
options.text: Shatter the false reality of humanity in one decisive blow as a synchronized global event.
options.rationale: The E.B.S. operation is a synchronized global event designed to shatter the false reality of humanity in one decisive blow.

options.label: C
options.text: Only pause local radio ads with no planetary intervention or false-reality shatter role.
options.rationale: It is a planetary intervention and worldwide communication takeover for disclosures.

options.label: D
options.text: Gently reinforce the false reality forever with no decisive blow or synchronized global disclosure.
options.rationale: E.B.S. is designed to shatter false reality in one decisive blow, not reinforce it.

questions.hint: Synchronized global event and one decisive blow.

questions.question: How are Truth Packages disseminated during this intervention?

options.label: A
options.text: Over several months, released a little at a time through the Cabal's own channels, which agree to the schedule as part of a deal with the Alliance.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Truth Packages are disseminated over a 72+ hour period, broadcast directly to the masses after military forces seize control of all media and internet channels.

options.label: B
options.text: As sealed paper files handed to courts and journalists, without any broadcast or media takeover.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Truth Packages are disseminated over a 72+ hour period, broadcast directly to the masses after military forces seize control of all media and internet channels.

options.label: C
options.text: After the Ascension reconstruction, once the realm is stable and the public is ready to hear them.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Truth Packages are disseminated over a 72+ hour period, broadcast directly to the masses after military forces seize control of all media and internet channels.

options.label: D
options.text: Over a 72+ hour period, broadcast directly to the masses after military forces seize control of all media and internet channels.
options.rationale: Truth Packages are disseminated over a 72+ hour period, broadcast directly to the masses after military forces seize control of all media and internet channels.

questions.hint: Duration and channel control after media and internet seizure.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, Truth Packages act as the catalyst for the Great Awakening, forcing the collective to confront the parasitic overlay and the crimes of the elite.

questions.question: What is the E.B.S. (Emergency Broadcast System) as a mechanism?

options.label: A
options.text: The worldwide communication takeover mechanism deployed by the Whitehats and military to broadcast disclosures and shatter the false reality.
options.rationale: E.B.S. is the worldwide communication takeover mechanism deployed by the Whitehats and military to broadcast disclosures and shatter the false reality.

options.label: B
options.text: A channel set up after the tribunals to keep a record of the disclosures, which the public can watch at any time once the reconstruction has begun.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. E.B.S. is the worldwide communication takeover mechanism deployed by the Whitehats and military to broadcast disclosures and shatter the false reality.

options.label: C
options.text: A local weather and safety loop, run by city authorities, with no worldwide reach and no part in the disclosure itself.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. E.B.S. is the worldwide communication takeover mechanism deployed by the Whitehats and military to broadcast disclosures and shatter the false reality.

options.label: D
options.text: A Cabal entertainment network that stays on air during the disclosure, competing with the military broadcasts for the attention of viewers.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. E.B.S. is the worldwide communication takeover mechanism deployed by the Whitehats and military to broadcast disclosures and shatter the false reality.

questions.hint: Worldwide communication takeover by Whitehats and military.

questions.question: What are Truth Packages defined as?

options.text: Optional five-minute rumors with no irrefutable proof of corruption, bloodlines, or parasite control.
options.rationale: They are concentrated 72+ hour releases of irrefutable proof, not optional short rumors.

options.label: B
options.text: Concentrated, 72+ hour data releases broadcast via the E.B.S.
options.rationale: Truth Packages are concentrated, 72+ hour data releases broadcast via the E.B.S. containing irrefutable proof of global corruption, bloodlines, and parasite control.

options.label: C
options.text: Only classified files never released on any military emergency channel to the masses.
options.rationale: They are broadcast via E.B.S. directly to the masses on the remaining military channel.

options.label: D
options.text: Only corporate ads praising elites with no bloodline or parasite-control documentation.
options.rationale: Content proves global corruption, bloodlines, and parasite control against the elite system.

questions.hint: Concentrated 72+ hour data releases via E.B.S. with irrefutable proof.

options.text: The hardest truths are shown first, to break the illusion in a single blow, and the softer material follows to help the population recover from the shock.

options.label: C
options.text: The truths are mixed with entertainment, so that viewers can take breaks between the harder parts of the broadcast.
